alt.en: A large gray screen showing chat bubbles stands at the center. A dashed orange line carrying two packets runs from a phone at the front left to the screen, a dotted teal line joins a teal terminal tile at the right to it, and a yellow warning sign stands behind on the right.
alt.zh: 画面中央立着一块显示对话气泡的灰色大屏幕。左前方的手机引出一条带两个数据包的橙色虚线通向屏幕，右侧青色终端图块以青色点线与屏幕相连，右后方立着一块黄色警示牌。

caption.en: Illustration: A phone standing for an attacking agent swarm sends instructions to a central chat screen that also takes in tool output from a teal tile, beside a warning sign that tool output carries less authority than the user. It does not depict the authors' attacker, the evaluated models or a tested deployment, and it does not show attack success rates.
caption.zh: 示意图：代表攻击智能体群的手机向中央对话屏幕发送指令，屏幕同时接收青色图块传来的工具输出，旁边的警示牌提醒工具输出的权威级别低于用户。本图并非作者的攻击系统、受测模型或经过测试的部署，也不代表任何攻击成功率。
